entities.name: Dellian Fel
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Arcavios, professor at Witherbloom College who returned from death with a spark. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: The college of Strixhaven where Fel is a professor.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Beings tied to nonlinear time that Fel studies.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle on first-name terms with Fel who reprimanded him.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A second-year elf student reprimanded by Fel.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A second-year student on the field trip.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who disappeared before Fel could discuss his theory.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: Site Fel combed for solutions and of the field trip.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A group students rumor Fel once worked for.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: Whose parents are old acquaintances of Fel.

events.summary: Fel is discovered dead in his lab, and after about thirteen months he rises from the grave with a Planeswalker's spark.
events.quote: his fellow faculty mourned his loss for about thirteen months, after which he rose from the grave

events.summary: Fel combs Titan's Grave for solutions and takes interest in the Archaics.
events.quote: He took particular interest in the Archaics

events.summary: Fel leads the field trip to Titan's Grave, where Jadzi greets the students.
events.quote: they were greeted by the Oracle Jadzi

events.summary: Fel reprimands Lluwen for injuring Ivarin, then finds him in a hole in the ground.
events.quote: Fel went to look for the elf and found him emerging from a hole in the ground

events.summary: Jadzi reprimands Fel for using the students for his own ends.
events.quote: Jadzi, who reprimanded him for using the students for his own ends

relations.quote: He is a professor in Witherbloom College at Strixhaven University .

relations.note: His professor on the field trip.
relations.quote: Fel organized the usual field trip to Titan's Grave with the second-year students, including Lluwen and Tamira
